messages:
sara_sales: quick sync — EnterpriseBank needs EU-only processing for the POC. They want assurance that all request/response payloads and model inference never leave EU boundaries, including failover scenarios. Also asked for a list of third-party subprocessors and KMS residency impact. Any immediate blockers for Hosted vs Dedicated?
ian_solutions: hosted offers EU endpoints but for strict "EU-only" we usually recommend Dedicated with tenant pinning. Hosted can fail over to other regions depending on capacity, which might not satisfy them.
mike_infra: +1. Dedicated + tenant peering + VPC egress keeps traffic in-customer-eu. We also need to pin model replicas to eu regions and disable cross-region failover for the tenant.
alice_security: heads-up — our BYOK KMS flow stores keys in the chosen cloud region, but some vendor metadata for HSM rotation crosses control plane boundaries. I'll check the HSM contract and add a clear statement to the questionnaire.
ian_solutions: Pricing sanity check: Dedicated POC baseline (1 reserved pool) + tenant-peering setup — rough ballpark: one-time setup ~ $10k-$15k, monthly commit for small POC ~$6k. Egress and peering costs separate. Can offer a POC discount; will confirm.
sara_sales: customer also asked for subprocessors inventory with locations. Do we have an up-to-date list we can share?
mike_infra: I have a short export — cloud provider (eu-west-1), metrics/observability vendor (eu-central-1), db backups (eu-west-2). Internal doc: https://redwood.internal/sproc/eu-2026 (will share as restricted link).
alice_security: note — observability vendor processes traces; for enterprise we can redact traces or opt them out per contract. I'll mark that in the answer.
ian_solutions: here's the tiny routing policy snippet they wanted to confirm:
```json
{"route_policy": "region:eu", "failover": "region:eu", "disallow_cross_border": true}
```
mike_infra: implementation notes: we need to set smart-routing policy + pin model variant and set tenant config: `tenant.routing.enforce_eu_only=true`. Also TLS peer certs for VPC peering and a cert rotation window. ETA for infra changes ~3-5 business days after sign-off.
alice_security: I'll add the KMS residency answer to the security questionnaire and attach vendor contract excerpts. Also adding a required data-flow diagram.
sara_sales: can someone draft a short one-page summary (tech + compliance + pricing + timeline) I can share with the customer today?
ian_solutions: I'll draft the technical + pricing note and attach the routing policy snippet.
mike_infra: I'll add infra prerequisites and timeline steps.
alice_security: looping in @olivia_legal for subprocessor addendum language.
olivia_legal: will review, looks OK but we need explicit language about geofencing and a simple data-flow diagram in the contract addendum.
deploy-bot: New PR merged: feature/tenant-pin-eu — CI passed :white_check_mark:

sara_sales: perfect, thanks everyone — I'll pull the draft together and send to EnterpriseBank this afternoon.
